# A customer carrying a key the format has no setter for, and one nobody would
# hand the customer: what the book's owner writes about them.
#
# Custom keys round-trip, so the export has to carry them. `print-invoice` is
# the other thing that renders an owner — and that page goes to the
# customer.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-PRIVATE"
	name: "Private Note Customer"
	currency: CAD
	addr[0]: "1 Any Street"
	email: "billing@example.com"
	credit_rating: "poor - chase early"

invoice "INV-PRIVATE"
	customer_id: "C-PRIVATE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-04-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-04-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-04-02
		due: 2026-05-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-PRIVATE"
		accumulate: true
